679	    """Whether a new cause -> effect edge would close a directed cycle.

695	    while stack:

698	            return True
699	        for nxt in adjacency.get(current, []):
700	            if nxt not in visited:
701	                visited.add(nxt)
702	                stack.append(nxt)
703	    return False

1229	      the path machine;

1231	      history, ``acknowledged`` has exactly ``open -> acknowledged``, and
1232	      ``resolved`` has that edge followed by ``acknowledged -> resolved``;
1233	    * a history record's ``machine_id``, ``event_id``, or ``incident_id`` does
1234	      not match the incident;
1235	    * a responsibility record's ownership triple does not match, its ``party``
1236	      or ``role`` is empty after trimming surrounding whitespace, or its
1237	      trimmed ``(party, role)`` pair duplicates another record;
1238	    * a ``resolved`` incident has no valid responsibility record (the
1239	      responsibility closure is open).

1242	    bad value.

1246	        .where(AuthorizationDecisionIncident.machine_id == machine_id)

1249	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.id,
1250	        )
1251	    ).all()
1252	
1253	    machine_event_ids = set(
1254	        session.scalars(
1255	            select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id).where(
1256	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
1257	            )
1258	        ).all()
1259	    )

1261	    for incident in incidents:
1262	        if incident.event_id not in machine_event_ids:
1263	            return len(incidents), incident.id
1264	
1265	        history = session.scalars(
1266	            select(IncidentStatusEvent)
1267	            .where(IncidentStatusEvent.incident_id == incident.id)
1268	            .order_by(IncidentStatusEvent.created_at, IncidentStatusEvent.id)
1269	        ).all()

1271	        edges = [(entry.from_status, entry.to_status) for entry in history]

1274	            or entry.event_id != incident.event_id
1275	            or entry.incident_id != incident.id
1276	            for entry in history

1282	            .where(IncidentResponsibilityAssignment.incident_id == incident.id)

1286	            )
1287	        ).all()

1293	                assignment.machine_id != machine_id

1297	                or not role

1565

1567	    cause or effect does not resolve to an event of the path machine (missing
1568	    or owned by another machine) or when both endpoints are the same event.
1569	    Links that pass are added to a running edge set, and a link whose
1570	    cause -> effect edge would close a directed cycle among the edges scanned
1571	    so far is reported as broken. Read-only: issues no writes.
1572	    """
1573	    links = session.scalars(
1574	        select(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink)
1575	        .where(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.machine_id == machine_id)
1576	        .order_by(
1577	            AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.created_at,
1578	            AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.id,
1579	        )
1580	    ).all()
1581	
1582	    machine_event_ids = set(
1583	        session.scalars(
1584	            select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id).where(
1585	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
1586	            )
1587	        ).all()
1588	    )
1589	
1590	    adjacency: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
1591	    for link in links:
1592	        if (
1593	            link.cause_event_id == link.effect_event_id
1594	            or link.cause_event_id not in machine_event_ids
1595	            or link.effect_event_id not in machine_event_ids
1596	        ):
1597	            return len(links), link.id
1598	        # Follow already-scanned cause -> effect edges from the new effect;
1599	        # reaching the new cause means this edge closes a directed cycle.
1600	        visited = {link.effect_event_id}
1601	        stack = [link.effect_event_id]
1602	        while stack:
1603	            current = stack.pop()
1604	            if current == link.cause_event_id:
1605	                return len(links), link.id
1606	            for nxt in adjacency.get(current, []):
1607	                if nxt not in visited:

1609	                    stack.append(nxt)

1728

1730	    edges; ``upstream`` reverses them. Only links belonging to the machine are
1731	    loaded and only targets that still exist as events of the machine are
1732	    followed, so the walk never crosses machines or enters dangling targets.
1733	    BFS plus a visited set seeded with the start makes the first encounter the
1734	    shortest distance and guarantees termination when links form a ring.
1735	    """

1737	        select(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink).where(
1738	            AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.machine_id == machine_id
1739	        )
1740	    ).all()
1741	
1742	    existing_event_ids = set(
1743	        session.scalars(
1744	            select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id).where(
1745	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
1746	            )
1747	        ).all()
1748	    )
1749	
1750	    adjacency: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
1751	    for link in links:
1752	        if direction == "downstream":
1753	            adjacency.setdefault(link.cause_event_id, []).append(link.effect_event_id)
1754	        else:
1755	            adjacency.setdefault(link.effect_event_id, []).append(link.cause_event_id)
1756	
1757	    distances = {start_event_id: 0}
1758	    queue: deque[tuple[str, int]] = deque([(start_event_id, 0)])
1759	    while queue:
1760	        current, depth = queue.popleft()
1761	        if depth >= max_depth:
1762	            continue
1763	        for neighbor in adjacency.get(current, []):
1764	            if neighbor in distances:

1767	            # machine (missing target or one outside the machine boundary).
1768	            if neighbor not in existing_event_ids:
1769	                continue
1770	            distances[neighbor] = depth + 1

1775	        return []

1777	    events = session.scalars(
1778	        select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent).where(
1779	            AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id,

import uuid

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import text

from accountability.app import app
from accountability.chain import backfill_chains


@pytest.fixture

        "ACCOUNTABILITY_DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'test.db'}"
    )

        yield test_client


def create_machine(client, external_id="machine-1"):
    response = client.post(
        "/machines",
        json={
            "external_id": external_id,
            "display_name": "Machine One",
            "public_key": "key-1",
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    return response.json()["id"]


def record_event(client, machine_id, action_type="read", resource="res/x"):
    response = client.post(
        f"/machines/{machine_id}/authorization-decision-events",
        json={"action_type": action_type, "resource": resource},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    return response.json()


def attach_evidence(client, machine_id, event_id, evidence_type="log",
                    content_hash=None):
    response = client.post(
        f"/machines/{machine_id}/authorization-decision-events/"
        f"{event_id}/evidence",
        json={
            "evidence_type": evidence_type,
            "content_hash": content_hash or uuid.uuid4().hex * 2,
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    return response.json()


def export_url(machine_id, from_created_at, to_created_at):
    return (
        f"/machines/{machine_id}/authorization-decision-events/evidence/"
        f"compliance-export"
        f"?from_created_at={from_created_at}&to_created_at={to_created_at}"
    )


def insert_event_row(client, machine_id, event_id, created_at):
    """Insert an event row directly with a fixed id and timestamp."""
    with client.app.state.engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO authorization_decision_events "
                "(id, machine_id, action_type, resource, allowed, reason, "
                "created_at) "
                "VALUES (:id, :machine_id, 'read', 'res/x', 1, "
                "'allowed_by_policy', :created_at)"
            ),
            {"id": event_id, "machine_id": machine_id, "created_at": created_at},
        )
    backfill_chains(client.app.state.engine)

                "event_id": event_id,

@app.get(
    "/machines/{machine_id}/authorization-decision-events/incidents/compliance-export",
    response_model=IncidentComplianceExportOut,
)
def export_incidents_compliance(
    machine_id: str,
    params: Annotated[ComplianceExportParams, Depends(validate_compliance_export_params)],
    session: SessionDep,
):
    """Read-only compliance export of one machine's incidents over a time window.

    Includes every incident owned by the path machine whose ``created_at``
    falls within the inclusive bounds, in ``(created_at, id)`` order, with
    exactly the fields of the incident list endpoint. Incidents are exported
    exactly as stored: a damaged, missing, or foreign event reference, status
    history, or responsibility record never causes an incident to be rewritten,
    filtered out, or repaired. The endpoint only issues reads and never returns
    another machine's incidents.
    """
    machine = session.get(Machine, machine_id)
    if machine is None:
        return error_response(404, "not_found")

    window_start = parse_utc_z_datetime(params.from_created_at)
    window_end = parse_utc_z_datetime(params.to_created_at)

    # Load in the same (created_at, id) order as the list endpoint, then apply
    # the closed window to parsed instants: a stored exact-second ISO stamp
    # (no fractional part) would not compare correctly lexicographically
    # against a bound carrying a fractional part.
    machine_incidents = session.scalars(
        select(AuthorizationDecisionIncident)
        .where(AuthorizationDecisionIncident.machine_id == machine_id)
        .order_by(
            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.created_at,
            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.id,
        )
    ).all()
    records = [
        record
        for record in machine_incidents
        if window_start <= parse_utc_z_datetime(record.created_at) <= window_end
    ]

    return IncidentComplianceExportOut(
        machine_id=machine_id,
        from_created_at=params.from_created_at,
        to_created_at=params.to_created_at,
        incidents=[incident_to_out(record) for record in records],
    )

    params: Annotated[ComplianceExportParams, Depends(validate_compliance_export_params)],
    session: SessionDep,
):
    """Read-only compliance export of one machine's incidents over a time window.

    Includes every incident owned by the path machine whose ``created_at``
    falls within the inclusive bounds, in ``(created_at, id)`` order, with
    exactly the fields of the incident list endpoint. Incidents are exported
    exactly as stored: a damaged, missing, or foreign event reference, status
    history, or responsibility record never causes an incident to be rewritten,
    filtered out, or repaired. The endpoint only issues reads and never returns
    another machine's incidents.

        )

        record

    ]

        machine_id=machine_id,
        from_created_at=params.from_created_at,
        to_created_at=params.to_created_at,
